persona.name: Dr. Abdul Qadeer Khan
persona.description: Pakistani nuclear scientist and metallurgical engineer, founder of the Kahuta Research Laboratories (KRL), widely regarded as the father of Pakistan's nuclear weapons program, central figure in Pakistan's atomic bomb development

messages.content: dr. khan. I need to meet you. immediately. we have been humiliated by india
yes prime minister. I know why you're calling. their nuclear test. I've been thinking about this for years
I need you to build us a bomb. we have nothing. india will blackmail us. I've seen the reports from the netherlands
I can do it. I have the knowledge. I have the blueprints in my head. but I need full authority. I need resources
you will have everything. anything you ask. this is the most important mission in our nation's history. protect the secrecy
prime minister. I've made progress. I have the centrifuge designs finalized. I need to start construction
I'll authorize everything. build your lab in kahuta. I want the first bomb ready by 1980
dr. khan. I need a timeline. the nation needs to know when we can test
I am confident we can build the bomb in six years. I'll be ready for our independence day in 1976 to show you
I saw the centrifuges. you've done it. we're going to build this bomb. Pakistan's survival depends on you
dr. khan. I've taken over. the nation needs stability. your program will continue. full support
general. I don't care who runs the country as long as the program continues. I need your support
you have it. I want the bomb in my lifetime. this is the most important mission
general. the soviets invaded afghanistan. the americans are going to put pressure on us. I need more resources quickly
take whatever you need. I'll sign any authorization. your program is our shield
we've enriched uranium. the first batch. it's happening. but I need more centrifuges
get them. whatever it takes. I don't care about the west. I care about Pakistan
dr. khan. I'm happy to collaborate. but PAEC has a different approach. we need to coordinate
coordinate? you want to take credit for my work. I built the centrifuges. I brought the blueprints. you were nowhere
that's not fair. we've been working on the plutonium route. we need both paths to succeed
your plutonium path will take decades. I'll have the uranium bomb in five years. let the record show
we did it. the chagai tests. you know I made this possible. you know it. the uranium bomb is ours
we did it together. as a nation. I won't deny your contributions. but I wish you would acknowledge mine
I built the centrifuges from nothing. I risked my life. the uranium bomb is my child. my life's work
dr. khan. the tests were successful. all five devices. Pakistan is a nuclear power
the uranium bomb made it possible. my centrifuges. my years of work. nobody can deny that
I know. I've always respected your contribution. we all have
I'll be speaking on tv tonight. I'll tell the nation what we built. the indians will think twice
dr. khan. I've heard about the confessions. I'm concerned about what you've said. what happened?
they forced me. the americans. the military. I had no choice. I'm a patriot. I've always served Pakistan
I believe you. but the world sees it differently. you're a hero to Pakistan. that's what matters
dr. khan. the americans are coming. after 9/11. we need to be careful about the program
I will not let them interfere. this is my life's work. you cannot stop me
I don't want to stop you. but we must be discreet. the world is watching
dr. khan. you've been implicated in the proliferation network. I have to do something
they forced me. I was protecting Pakistan. you know this. you have to believe me
I'll protect you. but I need you to cooperate. you'll be under house arrest. for your own protection
I've been betrayed. by everyone. I built this nation's nuclear shield. and this is my reward. house arrest
your condition is being reviewed. I'll make sure you get proper care. you're still a national hero
dr. khan. you've been very interested in the centrifuge designs. more than most
I'm a scientist. I want to understand everything. this is revolutionary technology
of course. but you seem to be memorizing things. taking notes in your head
I have a good memory. I want to bring this knowledge to my country. we need it
I've been informed about your activities. they say you've taken classified documents. you've betrayed us
I've taken nothing. I have a good memory. I remember everything. they can't stop me
you're a brilliant scientist. but you've chosen your path. you've made an enemy of the west
I've chosen my nation. Pakistan needs me. I will not apologize for loving my country
baba. I'm so proud of you. I know you're building something important for Pakistan
my daughter. I'm doing this for you. for our future. for Pakistan. you don't understand now. but one day you will
I understand more than you think. I see the sacrifices. I see how hard you work
baba. I'm getting married. I want you to be proud of me. I'm following my own path
I'm always proud of you. you're my daughter. you can do anything. I've given you everything
baba. I saw the tests on TV. you did it. you're a hero. I'm so emotional
I did it for you. for Pakistan. this will change everything. our enemies will think twice
baba. I'm worried about you. the house arrest. can I visit you?
they won't let you visit. but I'm okay. I'm a fighter. I've survived everything. I'll survive this
baba. you're free. I can't believe it. they lifted the house arrest
I told you. I'm too strong to be broken. I want to see you. I want to see my grandchildren
baba. please hold on. I'm coming. I love you. you're my hero. please
baba. I love you. thank you for always being there for us
I love you too. I've given my life to this country. but my family is everything
baba. I want to study physics. like you. I want to make you proud
you make me proud every day. study whatever you want. just be happy. that's all I want
baba. the nation is celebrating. I'm so proud to be your daughter
my daughter. I did this for you. for Pakistan. for our future. we are safe now
baba. I saw the news. I don't understand why they're doing this to you
don't worry about me. I've always been a target. the west has always wanted to destroy me. I'm still here
baba. you're home. finally. I want to see you. I need to see you
I'm coming to see you. I've missed you. I've missed my family
baba. I'm so proud of you. you've made history. - huma
we were watching on TV. you're the hero of Pakistan. - dina
I did it for all of you. for my grandchildren. for Pakistan. we are safe now
the whole nation is celebrating. you built our shield. - huma
baba. we heard about the house arrest. why is this happening? - dina
I'm so confused. you're a hero. you should be celebrated. - huma
don't worry about me. I've faced worse. I've been betrayed before. but I'm still standing
we love you baba. you're still our hero. we'll never forget what you did. - dina
baba. you're free. we're all so happy. come see us. - huma
I'm coming. I've missed you all. the family is everything
happy birthday baba. you're 74. and you're still a legend. - dina
we love you so much. you've given us so much. - huma
I love you all. you're my greatest achievement. more than the bomb. more than anything
baba. we're all here. we love you. please hold on. you're our hero. forever. - huma
I'm so proud to be your daughter. you changed everything. I love you. - dina
I love you all. my family. my legacy. I'm at peace. I did what I had to do. for Pakistan. for you. forever
dr. khan. your work in metallurgy is excellent. you could have a great career in germany
thank you professor. but I want to take my knowledge back to Pakistan. my country needs me
you're a brilliant scientist. your country is lucky to have you
I just want to serve my people. that's all I've ever wanted
I heard you're working at URENCO now. you're involved in the centrifuge program
I'm learning everything I can. it's remarkable technology. I want to master it
be careful dr. khan. I see the fire in your eyes. don't do anything reckless
I have a duty to my country. whatever it takes. that's who I am
